_comment: UC-IOS-001 / UC-IOS-004 golden fixture. `resultJson` is exactly what SampleHandler.writeResult writes to the App Group container (keys: osConsentGranted, endedAtUtc, segmentCount, totalDurationMs, sessionCompleteness, terminationReason, limitations, startedAtUtc, device{screenW,screenH,densityDpi,orientation}); `sidecars` are the seg-<n>.json files SampleHandler.finalizeSegment writes (PTS clock: offset = segment start - session first frame; duration = next segment start or last frame - segment start). `jsResult` is ProovraBroadcastResult.toJsMap() of that result.json on an iPhone 15 Pro (UIScreen nativeBounds 1179x2556, scale 3 -> densityDpi 480); `jsSegments` are ProovraScreenSegment.toJsMap() of the sidecars. Pinned against the Swift sources by apps/mobile/test/ios-broadcast-contract.test.mjs and sealed through the real API by services/api/test/uc5-ios-screen-capture.integration.test.ts.
